reviews.x: These had some iffy reviews so I wasn't sure what to expect. The box was slightly bent from shipping but the product inside was undamaged. The eyeliner bottle looks a little cheap but the eyeliner inside is smooth and has a thin brush that I felt was very easy to apply the product with. The liner and lashes worked exactly as described. Someone said that they felt like they had to put the eyeliner on pretty thick to make them stay, but I tried on my hand and one generous sweep was enough for them
I dont bother with reviews very often but these eyelashes are effen amazing!!!! Eyeliner goes on smooth and lashes popped right on. Soooooo easy will be buying more
Works great with magnets lashes stays on all day easy to remove

This is a cute set! The lashes are a bit big for me but you can easily trim them to the size most suitable to you. The liner goes on smoothly and easily and holds the lashes in place well. I'm always a bit afraid of the glue of other lash sets so this was a perfect compromise. Overall very pleased with these, I don't wear them daily, just for special occasions and these are perfect for that as they're dramatic.

I purchased both magnetic liner and lash just to try it. At first I was sceptical because of the other reviews I had read. To my surprise,  it actually works and it's so easy.  The trick is, you have to apply a good amount of liner. It doesn't have to be thick. Let completely dry, than apply the lash.  I'm happy with my purchase.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for...
reviews.x: There are many components to this product making me wonder how they can manufacture it for so cheap.  But, in the end, the product has to work.  The liner actually went on really smoothly.  Directions state to put several coats which I did.  It took a long time to dry (even with a blow dryer to speed up the process), and the liner never lost its glossy look.  The eyelashes stuck and went on easily, but the bond is very light.  I wouldn't trust going out into even the slightest breeze wearing the

No matter if you use a little or a lot of the liner once the lashes are on about 5-10 minutes later they lose their grip. I barely touched it to get it back where it belongs and the whole lash  came off. Save your money
The eyeliner came off within 2 hours, and did not hold the lashes on.
Either the eyeliner or the magnets on the lashes aren’t strong enough. They don’t adhere.
I put liner on let dry added lashes, when I blinked they came off!! Tried several times, liner comes off with just touching it! Disappointed, nothing like they advertised!
Shipment took forever. Product was damaged. Literally wasted money for me to just throw them away. Very unsatisfied.
It does NOT work!!  Don't waste your money!!
No se pegan como dice la publicidad. Un total desperdicio de dinero.
Did not stick well. Nothing like the ad for me at least.

reviews.t: Seems too good to be true? You’re right. These are garbage.
reviews.x: Lashes themselves are pretty, but this doesn’t work; at all.

Been using eyelashes for years. Again I'm a sucker for a new product. This did not meet my expectations. Lashes were nice & full but would not stay on. Tried different ways from the reviews. I ended up just using my glue instead. Would not recommend.

I've ordered these TWICE! I have never been successful applying strips or individuals.  These were a "snap" to use.  takes only minutes and last all day.  I keep them in the container when Im not wearing them.  LOVE THEM!
Did not like the way the magnets were attached to eyelashes. Assumed it be a magnetic strip of some sort, not little magnet squares on eyelashes.
The magnetic part of the eyeliner does not work like the video shows. It barely stayed on.

reviews.t: Might want to trim the length to make look more natural
reviews.x: The lashes are perfect in size but the length of lashes are very long. Looks super fake

reviews.t: Did not work so well for me
reviews.x: I could not get the  flashes to stick on

I have tried all the eyelash options out there. Lattise.. time-consuming, glue on..hard on lashes...individual lashes.. time-consuming, even professional applied lashes..expensive. But this technique is awesome. It you can put on liquid eyeliner you got it made. Once it dries they just clamp on. Lightweight, look real and do not damage your eyelashes. My new go to for lashes from here on out. Easy to remove too, soap and water will take them off. I use my makeup remover and poof liner is gone. W

This is by far the BEST purchase I have EVER made! I cannot wear mascara as my eyes are extremely sensitive so my lashes are always blah. I thought these would be worth a try. Well, I got them today and put them on perfectly on the first try. I put the liquid eyeliner on, waited a couple minutes for it to dry then used the applicator tool that came with them to put them on. It was so easy. They stay in place and feel very secure. Do not irritate my eyes at all and look fabulous!  I promise you t

These are the first pair of eyelashes I've successfully applied. I bought the expensive yellow brand and while they look absolutely fantastic I really struggled with them. These are not as realistic and soft looking but I got it right by the second try. The first try I didn't anticipate the texture of the eyeliner and made a bit of a mess. But it's a total win for me!! Also I added a little black eyeliner glue between the magnets for extra sticking power. Worked out.

reviews.t: Doesn't work and unable to receive a full refund!
reviews.x: I was so excited to use these products, but was very disappointed - the eye liner does not stay on your eyes and what does stay, the eyelashes DO NOT attach to!! :(  When I asked for a refund I was told I needed to return the product to KOREA!!!! The alternative was to have half the purchase price credited and keep the product. This was not the outcome I expected since the order was fulfilled by Amazon!!  Very dissapointed!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the lashes do not stay on and the liner loses its grip, often within minutes to a couple of hours.
Several reviewers report the product simply does not work as advertised.
A number of reviewers praise how easy the product is to apply and that the liner goes on smoothly.
Some reviewers say the lashes stay on all day and hold well when applied correctly.
A few reviewers mention shipping or damage issues, including a bent box and a damaged, unusable product.
